summaries.accounting_export: Export invoices and payments for the accountant (gestoría).
summaries.activity_journal: Append-only staff activity log recorded from module events.
summaries.billing: Invoices, payments, credit notes, PDF billing.
summaries.clinical_notes: Polymorphic clinical notes (administrative, diagnosis, treatment, treatment plan) with author. Attachments delegated to media.
summaries.contacts: Directory of external labs, suppliers, and other provider contacts.
summaries.copilot: Conversational AI agent over Dentum, scoped to the caller's permissions.
summaries.documents: Generates prescriptions, medical certificates, referral letters and radiology requests as branded PDFs with configurable clinic letterhead.
summaries.expenses: Fixed/recurring office expense tracking with monthly category totals.
summaries.gdpr: Data-subject rights, consents, retention and breach reporting (GDPR).
summaries.imaging_ai: On-demand AI segmentation jobs over imaging studies.
summaries.imaging_viewer: In-app DICOM study viewer (PNG render) indexed on media documents.
summaries.india_gst: CGST/SGST/IGST GST billing compliance for Indian clinics.
summaries.integrations: Webhook subscriptions (REST Hooks) for third-party automations.
summaries.inventory: Stock list with cost tracking, movement ledger, audit trail and consumable auto-deduction.
summaries.inventory_reorder: Reorder suggestions from 90-day usage and supplier lead times; generates draft purchase orders.
summaries.lab_orders: Track lab work orders per patient — from sent to received.
summaries.leads: Inbound leads from external forms: new enquiries become leads, known patients become recalls.
summaries.media: Patient documents, photos, X-rays + polymorphic attachments.
summaries.medical_reference: Managed allergy/medication/disease/surgery lists with searchable medical-history inputs and interaction/contraindication warnings.
summaries.medication_catalog: Clinic-wide medication list with dose/unit/form, seeded with a 56-item dental starter set.
summaries.migration_import: Importa datos de pacientes, citas, presupuestos, pagos y documentos desde un archivo DPMF generado por dental-bridge.
summaries.nav_online: NAV Online Számla — valós idejű számlaadat-szolgáltatás (HU).
summaries.notifications: Email templates, preferences, SMTP, event-driven sending.
summaries.odontogram: Dental charting, tooth state, clinical treatments.
summaries.orthodontics: Orthodontic case tracking — monthly controls, wires, photo evolution.
summaries.patient_segments: Clinic-local patient tags for grouping and campaigns.
summaries.patients: Patient identity: name, contact, demographics, status.
summaries.patients_clinical: Normalized medical history, allergies, medications, emergency contacts.
summaries.payment_gateways: Provider-neutral payment gateway contract, registry, and PaymentRequest lifecycle.
summaries.payments: Patient-centric collections, allocations to budgets / on-account, refunds, patient ledger, and dental payment reports.
summaries.payroll: Staff payroll with encrypted bank/tax data, periods, entries and reports.
summaries.periodontogram: SEPA periodontal charting — snapshots, probing sites, BoP/PI/CAL indices.
summaries.prescriptions: Clinical prescriptions with per-country compliance hooks.
summaries.purchase_orders: Purchase orders with receiving, quality checks and PDF export.
summaries.razorpay: Razorpay payment gateway — UPI, QR, cards, and payment links for India clinics.
summaries.recall_reminders: Connects recalls to the notifications gateway — auto-reminds patients when a recall is created.
summaries.recalls: Patient recalls: schedule call-backs, work the monthly call list, log attempts, auto-link booked appointments.
summaries.schedules: Clinic + professional operating hours, overrides, availability, and occupancy analytics.
summaries.sdi_it: FatturaPA / SDI — fatturazione elettronica B2B per l'Italia.
summaries.sistema_ts: Sistema Tessera Sanitaria — invio delle spese sanitarie dei pazienti (IT).
summaries.sms_gateway: SMS delivery for notifications via pluggable providers.
summaries.staff_attendance: Clock in/out events, current state, and daily pairing report.
summaries.staff_tasks: Staff handoff board — internal tasks and handoffs between team members.
summaries.supplier_items: Links inventory items to suppliers (multi-vendor, SKU and price).
summaries.supplier_ratings: Automatic delivery/quality metrics from PO history plus a manual 1-5 communication rating per supplier.
summaries.telephony: CTI: aviso en pantalla de llamadas entrantes + registro de llamadas.
summaries.treasury: Cash/bank accounts, transfers, and manual corrections.
summaries.treatment_consumables: Maps catalog treatments to inventory items with quantity per link.
summaries.treatment_plan: Patient treatment plans with budget + odontogram sync.
summaries.verifactu: Cumplimiento Veri*Factu (AEAT) para clínicas en España.
summaries.whatsapp_kapso: WhatsApp para notifications vía Kapso (Meta Cloud API).
summaries.whatsapp_webhook: WhatsApp para notifications vía webhook firmado (Zapier/Make/n8n).
